title: Hearty Garlicky Norwegian Pork Stew
description: A rich and flavorful Norwegian stew featuring pork, garlic, and a mirepoix base, perfect for a cold winter's night. This dish is plant-based friendly and can be made in a large kazan cauldron.
instructions: Heat oil in a large kazan cauldron over medium heat.
Add the chopped onions and cook until they are translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the sliced carrots and chopped celery and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the cubed pork shoulder and cook until browned on all sides.
Add the vegetable broth, tomato paste, thyme, and bay leaves, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1 1/2 hours, or until the pork is tender.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh thyme and crusty bread on the side.
Cook pork to an internal temperature of 63°C / 145°F and let it rest for 3 minutes before serving.
